title: Reusable PostgreSQL to SeaweedFS full exports

scope.source: PostgreSQL delivery views over existing marts
scope.runtime: One-off Docker jobs; no extra permanent service

contracts.configuration: Reviewed JSON per dataset: source, ordered columns/types/nullability, key, totals, destination, file/row-group limits
contracts.grain: One current invoice line or order line
contracts.money: Decimal128(18,2); tax rate decimal128(18,3); loss/overflow rejected; signed credits and optional order IDs preserved
contracts.empty: Rejected by both current dataset contracts
contracts.files: Parquet 2.6 with Zstandard; 5000 rows per group, 50000 per file by default

consistency.warehouse: Read-only REPEATABLE READ across independent source aggregates and ordered server cursor
consistency.source: No global source transaction/cutover boundary certified; loader commits independent archive batches
consistency.cross_dataset: Separate snapshots; no grouped invoice/order release
consistency.provenance: PostgreSQL snapshot ID/time, visible sales/v2 counts and source archive contract. Not a source contiguous watermark.

publication.layout: datasets/dataset=<name>/version=<n>/run_date=<UTC attempt day>/run=<UTC timestamp>-<uuid>/data/part-NNNNN.parquet and manifest.json; published/.../run=<id>.json
sequence: Read back every file and validate schema, primary-key order/uniqueness, required fields, bytes, hashes and exact totals
publication.discovery: Consumers only list published/, select an explicit run, follow exact manifest keys, and validate before use. No mutable latest pointer.
publication.storage_semantics: No multi-object atomicity, rename, conditional-write or ETag integrity assumption; same-VM fsync enabled. Immutability is an application convention, not WORM.

recovery.identity: Stable request ID, contract fingerprint, durable fsynced local journal and nonblocking OS lock
recovery.incomplete: Abandon old attempt and restart full extraction with fresh snapshot/path; no cross-snapshot continuation
recovery.ready: Revalidate and publish original attempt without opening a new DB snapshot
recovery.ambiguous_success: Identical existing publication accepted without rewriting it
recovery.corruption: Fail closed; restore exact data or explicitly switch to a new request
recovery.limits: Single writer host; no distributed serialization or cross-host exactly-once claim; automatic garbage collection disabled

security.database: Dedicated warehouse_exporter, only SELECT on three delivery views; no DML/DDL/underlying schema privileges; read-only default
security.s3_consumer: Independent Read/List warehouse-exports only; no PostgreSQL secret or network membership
security.bootstrap: Existing S3 admin credential used only for bucket setup
security.boundaries: Internal Docker network and filer UI are trusted lab admin surfaces; S3 access control is not hostile-tenant isolation

resources.limitations: Fixture acceptance is not production capacity. No Spark deployment until volume/throughput measurements justify it.

rollback: Stop new jobs; keep last accepted consumer snapshot and all data/journal/secrets. Additive SQL migration 005 does not affect the loader. Do not edit applied migrations or reset offsets.
deferred: Real application transactional snapshot replacement and cutover
Off-VM recovery, replication, retention and WORM
Safe CDC purge and full SQL Server decommissioning

references.supports: Server-side cursors and bounded client retrieval
Bucket-scoped S3 identities; exact permissions verified against deployed version

conventions: Directory layout, publication protocol and request-journal design are project decisions, not claims of a universal enterprise standard.
